label: A necessary concrete power-holder for no contingent concretum, by Aristotelian modality
description: Test 5's route to a necessary concrete being. Not a transcription: no premise mentions a necessary being. Establishes no premise. It uses neither PGP nor C2 (controls, prussWithoutPGP); each non-logical premise is needed (controls, six Pruss omission models). It is not independent of the C2 crux's modal theory: P1 is power-grounded modality applied to a global possibility, and with a transfer bridge it yields PGP's power channel for every concrete contingent being (controls, laws 5-6).
